item.description:
What's new in 1.0.1

  • Inserting the last screenshot works again. The image never made it to the clipboard — only the text beside it did, which is why chat windows said nothing had arrived.
  • Recording now shows the same voice wave as dictation, and every mark you set is confirmed in red for a moment.
  • A recording that was interrupted mid-processing is finished on the next launch instead of being lost. Quitting waits for it.
  • The steps after you let go read Listened, Processing, Inserted.
  • The bundle count is right the first time, and it's called a bundle everywhere.
